alerts.title: New abdominal pain on TDF/3TC/DTG requires ADR screening
alerts.message: Guidelines require all health workers to screen every encounter for suspected adverse drug reactions using the Drug Safety Screening checklist, and to record and report any suspected ADR, mild or severe. Patient P004 (37F, on TDF/3TC/DTG since March 2023) presents with new abdominal pain without fever and with preserved appetite. Abdominal pain is not specifically named among the excerpted DTG or TDF toxicities, so drug attribution cannot be established from the excerpts; the symptom may be unrelated to ART. Creatinine (82 umol/L) and viral load (25 copies/mL) were checked 78 days before the visit, and no abdominal examination findings are documented. The clinician's plan does not record any ADR screening or ADR reporting.

evidence.recommended_action: Complete the Drug Safety Screening checklist for this encounter, characterise the abdominal pain, examine the abdomen, and record and report any suspected ADR to the HMIS and NDA per the reporting pathway.
